subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` plus `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should this wait for explicit named-new syntax or canonical title migration?
rationale: The code uses the existing label contract, but the user-facing command grammar overlaps active `/new`, `/name`, and title-migration work, so automation cannot choose the permanent UX contract safely.

options.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
options.body: Land the documented Control UI-only `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` behavior on the existing label persistence path.

options.title: Require explicit naming syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to preserve bare `/new` expectations and use `/label`, `/name`, or `/new --name` style naming instead.

options.title: Wait for title migration
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical `title` migration or broader command PR establishes the permanent naming contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the documented Control UI-only `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` behavior on the existing label persistence path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest merged history for dashboard New Chat and the accepted `/name` command direction.
